Think Tank Recommends Reducing Ethanol Blend in Petrol

A paper by the Indian Council for Research on International Economic Relations (ICRIER) suggests the Indian government consider temporarily reducing the ethanol component in petrol from 20% to 15%. This recommendation is based on supply constraints. The paper advocates for a flexible approach to the ethanol-blended petrol program.
